Bash(agent-browser --session qa eval "\(\(\) => {const btns = Array.from\(document.querySelectorAll\('button'\)\); const back = btns.find\(b => /Back/.test\(b.getAttribute\('aria-label'\) || ''\) || /Back/.test\(b.textContent\)\); if\(back\){back.click\(\); return 'back';} return 'no back';}\)\(\)")

Bash(agent-browser --session qa eval "\(\(\) => {const btns = Array.from\(document.querySelectorAll\('button'\)\); const stats = btns.find\(b => /Stats/i.test\(b.textContent\) && !b.textContent.includes\('HOME'\)\); if\(stats\){stats.click\(\); return 'stats';} return 'no stats';}\)\(\)")

Bash(agent-browser --session qa eval "\(\(\) => {const btns = Array.from\(document.querySelectorAll\('button'\)\); const back = btns.find\(b => /^Back$/.test\(b.textContent.trim\(\)\)\); if\(back\){back.click\(\); return 'back';} return 'none';}\)\(\)")

Bash(agent-browser --session qa eval "\(\(\) => {const btns = Array.from\(document.querySelectorAll\('button'\)\); const home = btns.find\(b => /HOME/.test\(b.textContent\)\); if\(home\){home.click\(\); return 'home';} return 'no';}\)\(\)")
